blocks.raw: <WikiExamTable headers={["Function", "What DHSUD Does", "Key Laws", "What DHSUD Does NOT Do"]} rows={[["Developer Regulation", "Issues License to Sell; reviews project compliance with PD 957; approves subdivision plans and condominium projects", "PD 957", "Does not build housing; does not finance projects"], ["CLUP Review and Approval", "Reviews LGU CLUPs for national conformity; approves or requests revisions; ensures alignment with national policies", "RA 7160, RA 11201", "Does not prepare CLUPs (that is the LGU's role); does not enforce zoning (that is the LGU's role)"], ["Housing Policy Formulation", "Issues IRR for housing laws; sets national standards for housing design and affordability; coordinates agencies", "RA 7279, RA 10884, and others", "Does not directly implement programs (NHA, Pag-IBIG, and others do)"], ["Complaint Resolution", "Adjudicates disputes between developers and buyers; enforces buyer protection laws", "PD 957, RA 6552", "Does not mediate between buyers and financial institutions (SSS, GSIS, Pag-IBIG disputes go to those agencies)"]} />

blocks.raw: <Tip>**Memory aid:** DHSUD = regulatory (oversees, approves). Does NOT: build, finance, zone, enforce locally. That belongs to NHA, Pag-IBIG, and LGUs.</Tip>
